title: Generic React Best Practices
note: It is a delta on top of `vercel-react-best-practices`: apply both.
abstract: Opinionated React/TypeScript guidelines for any front-end app (React 19, TanStack Query v5, Jotai, Yup, react-i18next, Jest + React Testing Library), designed for AI agents and LLMs. It is the author's own take on a best-practices guide, complementary to vercel-react-best-practices: domain-first architecture and import boundaries, API hooks and server state, query keys and cache invalidation, domain types, Yup schemas, UI composition and accessibility, Jotai client state, helpers, i18n, testing and code quality. Each rule includes a rationale and incorrect vs. correct examples using generic business vocabulary.
